query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN equipamentoSistemaId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Com ID' ELSE 'Sem ID' END as status,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  SUM(custo) as total
FROM item_despesa_importado
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY status;
